description:
One action on one open bank movement (ZEN-2), with its row's ``version``: ``accept`` its
held proposal, ``ignore`` it, ``skip`` / ``unskip``. Ignore and skip need a ``reason``;
recorded with your user. Link and settle through the row's ``operations``. Returns the new
status.

On this MCP surface a `null` argument means "not provided": it is dropped before the request is sent, exactly as if the field were omitted.
name: reconcile_bank_act
